name: smwblocks-teleport-on-time
title: Teleport on Time
description:
Teleports the player depending on the time limit.

Includes a define to invert the condition.

Note that this uses decimal mode and due an old bug in the SD2SNES/FXPak, issues might occur when using SA-1 in this flash cart. The newest firmware doesn't have this issue, so use that.
